description: This file contains functions to build payloads for traces and spans related to Opik traces within a monitoring or telemetry context. It defines two main functions: build_trace_payload and build_span_payload, which generate structured payload objects using provided parameters, including timestamps, response data, metadata, and usage statistics.

methods.description: Constructs a trace payload object with details about the trace, including timings, response object, metadata, tags, and thread ID.
